summary.name: Graduating from Bootcamp and interested in becoming a Site Reliability Engineer?
summary.one_liner: The URL was a Medium article by Tammy Butow about becoming a Site Reliability Engineer after a bootcamp, but the page returned a Cloudflare security block instead of the article text.
use_cases: reading guidance on moving into site reliability engineering
planning a career path after a coding bootcamp
summary.what_it_does: The page text available is only a Cloudflare security block message stating the site blocked the request, likely triggered by a word, phrase, SQL-like command or malformed data. It does not contain the article's content, so no details about the advice given can be confirmed. The listing from dastergon/awesome-sre names the piece as a resource about graduating from a bootcamp and becoming an SRE. The block page suggests emailing the site owner with the Cloudflare Ray ID.
notable: Medium article by Tammy Butow listed in awesome-sre under Education
Page content was blocked by Cloudflare security, so the article text was not retrieved
caveats: Article text could not be read; the page only shows a security block message
Access may be blocked for the reader too; retrying or using another browser may be needed
